derivation: Note 7 (PP&E) discloses opening NBV of $147,596,498.36, a depreciation charge of $21,365,208.91 for the year, and closing NBV of $153,844,194.18. The note explicitly states there were no disposals of property, plant and equipment during the year, so disposals = 0. No explicit cash-flow statement line for PP&E purchases/additions is provided in the extract, so direct_capex_line is null. Capex is not stated as a single ready-made figure, so capex_value is null; it would be derived as closing_nbv - opening_nbv + depreciation - disposals = 153,844,194.18 - 147,596,498.36 + 21,365,208.91 - 0 = 27,612,904.73 (computed by S4, not by this extraction).
